_: Shared golden for the /api/capture bearer credential. One constant, checked against THREE independent implementations of 'the digest of this token': webapp/tests/unit/capture-token.test.ts (node:crypto, what the route computes), tests/db/test_capture.py (Postgres's own encode(sha256(convert_to(...,'UTF8')),'hex'), what hq_mint_capture_token stores), and tests/core/test_capture_contract.py (the token SHAPE the migration mints and the route parses). Regenerating these values is a deliberate act — the point is that nothing here is derived at test time by the code under test.
